_what: Every artifact authored in BOSS's gitignored /.claude/ workspace, and whether it has crossed into the product a founder installs. THIS FILE IS TIER 2 — tracked here, absent from package.json `files:`, so it never reaches a founder's project.
_why: BOSS is self-hosted, so every agent and skill gets authored in the workspace first. Crossing is a deliberate act (/boss-learn routes it) and nothing caught what never got routed: 12 agents and 5 skills sat uncrossed and unexamined while shipped files pointed at four of them by name. `not-yet` is a legitimate verdict and always will be. `unexamined` is not — that is the only state this ledger exists to make impossible.

_verdicts.crossed: Ships under stages/*/template/ or library/. Verified to exist by check:boundary.
_verdicts.not-yet: Belongs to founders in principle; has not earned the port yet. Carries a reason, and the reason is re-read, not inherited.
_verdicts.internal: Examined, and the answer is no. Serves BOSS's own construction and would not survive contact with a founder's project.

_enforced_by: TWO gates, and this line used to claim ONE did both. `scripts/check-boundary.js` fails on an unexamined artifact and on a `crossed` verdict whose file does not exist — it has never contained a naming check, and the sentence asserting it did was corrected 2026-08-24 (v0.235.0). NAMING is `scripts/check-refs.js` class 4: a shipped file naming an `internal` or `not-yet` AGENT in backticks. Its scope was `stages/` + six named docs until v0.235.0, which added `library/` — practices ship in package.json `files:` and `boss craft` prints them to a founder's terminal, so `mentor-humane` sat backticked twice in `conscience-voicing.md` and no gate could see it. Two limits that remain, stated rather than implied: backticks are required (a bare word in prose is usually the concept), and SKILLS are covered only via the supersedes ledger, not this file — so a `not-yet` skill named in shipped prose is still caught by nothing here.

Authored 2026-08-20 after the audit found four skills had been naming it as a runnable step while it existed nowhere — ten passes had been run by hand. It serves BOSS curating BOSS; a founder needs no skill for this, because their host already searches the web and /persona now says so directly.

artifacts.name: prompt-coach
artifacts.why: Ships at Quickstart as of v0.236.0. Its own description had said "outward-facing counterpart to voice-keeper" — it was AUTHORED for founders and never left the workspace, so crossing it delivered something already written for them rather than adding something new. Landed at L0 rather than MVP because asking well is load-bearing from the first prompt, and the cohorts it helps most (`first-product`, `vibe-coder-newbie`) meet Claude on day one; L0 seated three agents. Two things were WRONG in the workspace copy and fixed on the way over: `tools: Read, Edit` could not create the pattern library the agent promises to "create on first use" (Edit needs an existing file) — now the house line, `Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write`; and it told the founder it does not replace `voice-keeper`, an agent that ships to nobody.

artifacts.name: vet
artifacts.why: THE CLEAREST MISS. A founder faces "some thread says you must do X" constantly, and has nothing for it — while nine shipped practices were still pointing at this skill by name (fixed v0.178.0). 270 lines, so porting is real work, and the NO-biased rubric is tuned to BOSS's principles rather than a founder's. Port it scoped to the founder's own build, or don't; do not leave it unexamined.
